notes.title: Chicken Feet: Breakout Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42844500/1318b33f490454ad67136e489892d2daa72291ff.png[/img]

Chicken Feet: Breakout is a psychological, claustrophobic, and haunting horror experience. You play as a scientist in the midst of Cooper the Chicken’s breakout as you search for an escape. Without the aid of a radio, you are alone as you descend into the darkness. Will you survive or endure the same fate as your colleagues?

This update includes the short story expansion, "Breakout", alongside a few small map changes in the main campaign.

Other additions include Steam achievements, improvements to the settings menu, and a reduction in the game's file size.

Watch the release trailer here:
[previewyoutube=EQyrzy_EIac;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 1.1 - 11/14/22

- Updated credits to include the soundtrack ("Dead Ark - Classic Horror Sci-Fi Music Pack" by Sylwester Faustmann)
